[[Gift of Skirmishing]] is a [[structured PvP]] reward used to craft the [[legendary back item]] [[The Ascension]] and the [[legendary trinket]] [[Transcendence]].

== Acquisition ==
{{recipe
| source = mystic forge
| ingredient1 = 2 Vision Crystal
| ingredient2 = 250 Shard of Glory
| ingredient3 = 5 Certificate of Support
| ingredient4 = 1 Perfect Mist Core
}}

[[de:Gabe der Gefechtsbeherrschung]]
[[es:Don de escaramuzas]]
[[fr:Don d'escarmouche]]

== Notes ==
{{anomaly|The tooltip implies that it can only be used to craft a [[legendary back item]] which is not correct as [[Transcendence]], a [[legendary trinket]], can also be crafted with it.}}
